# graylog_entity_share (Resource)

Manages Graylog entity shares using grantee capabilities.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "graylog_entity_share" "example" {
  entity_grn = "grn::::stream:000000000000000000000001"

  grantee_capabilities = {
    "grn::::builtin-team:everyone" = "view"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `entity_grn` (String) Entity GRN to share, e.g. `grn::::stream:<id>`.

### Optional

- `grantee_capabilities` (Map of String) Map of grantee GRN to capability (`view`, `manage`, or `own`).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier (same as entity_grn).
